ai.title: Google DeepMind CEO warns of safety risks
ai.description: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis predicts Artificial General Intelligence could arrive within five years but warns of risks without proper safety measures. He calls for global standards to prevent misuse in cybersecurity, biothreats and beyond, comparing AGI’s impact to fire or electricity.
ai.title_cn: Google DeepMind首席执行官警告安全风险
ai.description_cn: Google DeepMind首席执行官Demis Hassabis预测人工通用智能可能会在五年内问世，但警告称，如果没有适当的安全措施，可能存在风险。他呼吁制定全球标准，防止网络安全、生物威胁等领域的滥用，并将AGI的影响与火灾或电力进行了比较。

ai.title: George Lucas says AI makes it ‘much easier’ to make movies.
ai.description:
In an interview with A Rabbit’s Foot, the man who loves pushing technological boundries enough to anger his fans with controversial remasters had this to say about people who oppose artificial intelligence in film making:
> “It’s very much like sitting here saying, ‘Well, I believe the horse and the buggy is really where it’s at. These cars, they break down, they need gas, there’s all kinds of problems with them and pretty soon they’ll be making them into tanks, and then they’ll be killing people. It’s terrible.’ There’s nothing you can do about it. That’s progress, it’s the future.”
ai.title_cn: 乔治·卢卡斯表示，人工智能让制作电影变得“容易得多”。
ai.description_cn:
在接受《兔子脚》采访时，这位喜欢突破技术界限，以至于用有争议的重制版激怒粉丝的人对那些反对电影制作中人工智能的人这样说道：
'这就像坐在这里说，‘好吧，我相信马和马车真的就在那里。这些汽车，它们会抛锚，需要汽油，它们有各种问题，很快它们就会把它们制成坦克，然后它们就会杀人。太可怕了。'你对此无能为力。这是进步，这是未来。”
